messages.text:
"OPEN WORLD FANTASY RPG — ELDORIA: THE LOST REALMS

Create a beautiful, immersive, fully playable 3D open-world fantasy RPG with high-quality graphics and realistic environmental interactions.

1. WORLD DESIGN

Create a massive medieval fantasy world featuring:

- Vast green valleys and rolling hills.
- Snow-covered mountains and distant peaks.
- Dense forests with thousands of trees.
- Medieval villages, castles, bridges, and ancient ruins.
- Rivers, lakes, waterfalls, and oceans.
- Hidden caves, abandoned temples, and mysterious locations.
- A seamless explorable world with no unnecessary loading screens.

2. GRAPHICS AND RENDERING

Aim for high-quality modern 3D game visuals.

Implement:

- Real-time dynamic sunlight.
- Realistic directional lighting.
- Dynamic shadows.
- Screen-space reflections where supported.
- Realistic water reflections.
- Physically based rendering (PBR).
- High-quality terrain textures.
- Atmospheric fog and volumetric-looking clouds.
- Beautiful sunrise, sunset, and nighttime lighting.
- Realistic environmental color grading.

Visual inspiration: beautiful medieval fantasy environments with cinematic lighting, detailed landscapes, and natural scenery.

3. REALISTIC WATER PHYSICS

Water should have:

- Animated waves and ripples.
- Realistic sunlight reflections.
- Character interaction with water.
- Water splashes when characters enter or move through water.
- Dynamic ripples around moving objects.
- Flowing rivers and waterfalls.

4. ENVIRONMENTAL INTERACTIONS

Make the world feel alive:

- Grass moves with the wind.
- Trees and leaves sway naturally.
- Flowers and vegetation react to environmental forces.
- Day and night cycles.
- Dynamic weather: rain, fog, wind, and thunderstorms.
- Realistic environmental particle effects.

5. CHARACTER SYSTEM

Create a fully animated third-person playable character.

Include:

- Walking, running, sprinting, and jumping.
- Swimming.
- Climbing where appropriate.
- Sword combat.
- Dodging and parrying.
- Smooth character animations.
- Responsive mobile controls.

6. WORLD EXPLORATION

Include:

- Large explorable regions.
- Medieval settlements.
- NPCs with basic daily routines.
- Wildlife and fantasy creatures.
- Interactive objects.
- Hidden treasures.
- Exploration quests.
- A functional world map and compass.

7. GAMEPLAY

Create a functional RPG system:

- Health and stamina.
- Inventory.
- Equipment and weapons.
- Enemy AI.
- Combat system.
- Quest system.
- Save and load progression.

8. GRAPHICS OPTIMIZATION

The game must support mobile browsers.

Provide:

- Scalable graphics settings.
- Low, Medium, High, and Ultra presets.
- Adjustable render resolution.
- Level of detail (LOD).
- Optimized vegetation rendering.
- Efficient shadow and reflection quality.
- Stable performance on different devices.

9. IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS

Do not create a static scene or simple visual demonstration.

Build an actual playable 3D open-world RPG with functional movement, exploration, combat, environmental interactions, and game systems.

Prioritize visual quality, realistic environmental details, smooth animations, and immersive exploration.

Start by generating a fully playable vertical slice containing a beautiful medieval village, surrounding forest, mountains, and a realistic river. Expand the world after the core systems work correctly.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
